neighborhoods: New York City; wildlife-rehab area + cat sanctuary on Roosevelt Island (SouthPoint Park)

notes: NYC 501(c)(3) (NYS Ag & Markets reg. RR350) with a state- and federally-licensed wildlife rehabilitator. Rescues, rehabilitates and releases injured/orphaned NYC wildlife; runs a wildlife-rehab area alongside its Roosevelt Island cat sanctuary. An in-city wildlife-rehab option (complements the Wild Bird Fund and WINORR). Contact by email; confirm species/capacity first.
